scope: 336 actual 8x8 opening-board element screenshots: 21 themes × 8 piece surfaces × High visibility on/off. Center-face versus empty playable-square contrast is a conservative legibility screen; rim measurements are diagnostic only because gloss, engraved grooves, shadows and the fine dual-tone keyline intentionally vary. Contact sheets retain visual context. Does not certify flags, crowns, move/capture animations or reduced motion.
viewport: isolated Chromium, board element rasterized at 514×514 including 1px frame; inner 512×512 board sampled.
sampling: For each of 24 opening discs, compare the 3×3 median face-center patch with an empty playable-square center on the same column. Also compare 32 rim/background angular pairs at 0.34- and 0.46-cell radii.
